idea-plugin.name: Lazy Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Generate meaningful Git commit messages with AI, right from the Commit tool window.

Features:
  • One-click "AI Generate" button on the Commit toolbar
  • Reads the staged diff and generates a commit message following the Conventional Commits specification
  • Works with any OpenAI-compatible API (custom base URL, model list fetching, connection test)
  • Interruptible generation - the button turns into a stop action while generating
  • Your diff is sent only to the AI endpoint you configure - no data is collected
Configuration: Settings → Tools → Lazy Commit.

在 Commit 工具窗口提供一键生成 Commit Message 的按钮。读取当前 staged diff， 调用 AI（OpenAI 兼容接口）生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的提交信息并自动填充。 支持自定义接口地址、拉取模型列表、测试连接，生成过程可中断。 配置入口：Settings → Tools → Lazy Commit。

action.description: 根据 staged diff 调用 AI 生成提交信息
